raw.title: The Mill Road
raw.description: An authored act on a mill road, continued by the director after its end.

living.premise: A miller's road where a flood took the bridge; the authored act ends when the ford is found.

qualities.rubric: How does the miller treat the player?
Did anyone reach the far bank of the river?

checkpoints.name: The Mill
checkpoints.objective: The miller refuses to grind until the road is open.

checkpoints.name: The Ford
checkpoints.objective: The river is low enough to cross at the ford.

checkpoints.name: Toward The Far Bank at Dusk
checkpoints.objective: Across the low water, a lantern sways on the far bank where the road climbs away from the river; whoever carries it has not yet noticed the crossing is passable.
